items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and the interviewee as David Finck; no personal interaction or relationship described between them beyond the interview setting.

ctx.x: David was interviewed in Utica, New York on May 29, 2015 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Utica, New York. I’m pleased to have musician David Finck with me. And congratulations on playing the best instrument.
Well I don’t know about that. It doesn’t feel like that all the time. But it’s been mine for years now.
